content.value: <sub>7(a).</sub> J\n 8-lb weight is placed upon the lower end of a coil spring suspended from the ceiling. The weight comes to rest in its equilibrium position, thereby stretching the spring 6 inches. The weight is then pulled down 3 inches below its equilibrium position and released at $\mathrm { { t } } = 0$ with an initial velocity of I ft/sec, directed downward. cglecting the resistance of the medium and assuming that no external forces arc present, determine the amplitude, period, and frequency of the resulting motion.
